To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
student privacy is a major issue for the field of educational datamining.
the transition from academic EDM research to industry is difficult due to student privacy concerns.

the transition from academic research to industry practice in the domain of educational data mining is challenging, and that there are three primary areas of difficulty: policy, corporate responsibility, and public perception.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how the EDM community can support industry adoption of EDM technologies.
the following questions: How can we best protect student privacy in practice? How can we help the EDM community to transition into industry?
the question: How can EDM applications be developed in ways that are both innovative and responsible?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the EDM community needs to take the concerns of stakeholders into consideration when developing and deploying their technologies.
the EDM community should take a proactive role in the discussion of student privacy and the responsible use of student data.
EDM has the potential to be a very powerful tool for improving student education, however, there are many challenges that must be overcome in order for EDM to become a reality in industry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there are many opportunities and challenges for EDM in the industry.

the EDM community can play an important role in the development and implementation of student privacy policies, the promotion of corporate social responsibility in the industry, and the education of the public on the value of EDM technologies.
the field of EDM must be cognizant of and prepared for the challenges of privacy and data security that will inevitably arise as the field transitions from research to production.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the EDM community must be aware of these challenges and be prepared to respond to them.
the EDM community must be proactive in its approach to student privacy and data mining in practice.
EDM researchers must be prepared to address the concerns of a wide range of stakeholders when transitioning their work from the laboratory into practice.
